notes.title: New game project announced.
notes.content:
The project has been in the works for nearly a year now, and now, with the very first screenshot, along with two blog posts available, I would like to make an announcement. Progress has been quite slow recently, so there isn't much to see at the moment, but I'm trying hard to get as much attention as I can.

One important thing is that I'm trying to distance myself away from Gone In November, so these two are going to be vastly different games. I've read nearly every single negative reviews, took notes, improved certain aspects. If you're interested, consider leaving a comment, following, or share the blog so it'll get noticed - there will be a lot to come!

Project's development blog: https://florastamine.tumblr.com/ (I often do blogs 1-2 times/month)

Also, the game is using a custom-made engine (also by myself) which is released for free and can be downloaded at: https://github.com/Florastamine/FlockSDK

Flor.

notes.title: Korean translation added!
notes.content:
First of all, I want to give a big shout out to Sangbok Lee, who goes by the nickname of anemochore (http://steamcommunity.com/id/anemochore) - he did all the hard work of diassembling game files and provided me the complete, working patch! Now the game is also available in Korean! 

To switch to the Korean language, please first switch to your games library, then right-click on the game and choose "Properties". The option to choose the Korean language is located under the "BETA" tab. To revert back to the original language, simply choose "NONE - Opt out of all beta programs".

Also, Gone In November is -50% off during the Winter Sale! ːsteamhappyː

notes.content:
